name: Rome
intro: Explore 782 mapped Edilizia Residenziale Pubblica (ERP) property records from Roma Capitale’s public property atlas. Each marker is an official property point, not a vacancy or apartment-level census.
mapLabel: Interactive map of public-housing properties in Rome
footnote: 782 official property locations. Roma Capitale’s public atlas returns 790 ERP records; two lack published coordinates and six repeat an identical published point, so 782 distinct locations are shown. This is the currently published municipal layer, not a census of every social home in Rome.
